title: EL4CTEO/fast-anything
why_read: A pragmatic, well-scoped tool that automates the common 'profile then rewrite the hot path' optimization pattern using a coding agent, instead of blanket rewrites into Rust.
analysis: This tool pushes back against the common advice to fully rewrite slow applications in Rust, instead automating the targeted workflow of profiling a Python, Node, or Ruby app to find the actual hot functions and porting just those pieces. It uses a coding agent to perform the port and then verifies behavioral equivalence between the original and ported code, which addresses a real risk in automated rewrites. This is a practical, narrowly scoped application of AI coding agents to a well-understood performance engineering pattern rather than a flashy but vague use case. Worth a look for engineers who want faster hot paths without committing to a full language migration.
